title: Choose the weight scale for tanh and for ReLU
brief: Write the Xavier and He scales, measure what a ReLU does to a signal's size, and check on a fifty-layer network that He keeps the signal alive and Xavier does not.
hints: xavier_scale and he_scale return a standard deviation, so take the square root of 2 / (n_in + n_out) and of 2 / n_in.
relu_mean_square_ratio is np.mean(np.maximum(x, 0.0) ** 2) divided by np.mean(x ** 2). Use the mean square, not np.var, because np.var subtracts the mean.
On symmetric data the ratio is close to 0.5. If you get about 0.25, you squared the ReLU output twice.
